question.text: The mass of zinc produced by the electrolysis of zinc sulphate solution with a steady current of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>015</mn><mo> </mo><mi>A</mi></math> for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>15</mn></math> minutes is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>_</mo><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math>. (Atomic mass of zinc <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>=</mo><mn>65</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>amu</mi><mo>)</mo></math>

solution.text:
Given, t = 15 min

Zn+2+2e-⟶Zn

Quantity of charge passed (Q) =Current in amperes ×Time in seconds.
=(0.015A)×(15×60)s=13.5C

Gram equivalent mass of zinc = 65.42=32.7g
Now,  96500 C of charge deposit zinc =32.7 g
13.5 C charge will deposit zinc = (32.7g)(96500C)×(13.5C)=4.57×10−3 g

=45.75×10-4gm
